title: Remove bouquet element and add large 🌹 emoji above the first romantic line

requirements.text: Remove the bouquet element currently rendered above the first romantic line in `TimedRomanticLines` (the bouquet image loaded from `/assets/generated/rose-bouquet-sketch.dim_1400x900.png`) so that nothing related to the bouquet is displayed there.

quotes: the bouquet emoji wont show just remove it
no boquete moji is showing above i brought u rose today.

acceptanceCriteria: No bouquet image is rendered above the romantic lines at any time.
The timed 3-line sequence behavior remains unchanged (timing, once-per-page-load behavior, no looping/blinking).

requirements.text: Add a single text emoji line containing exactly "🌹" directly above the first romantic line “I brought you a rose today…” in the `TimedRomanticLines` section, styled like the existing bottom emoji line (the 😍 line used in the final-stage lip-biting section), and make the 🌹 emoji a bit larger using font-size only (do not convert to an image).

quotes: bro add 🌹 above i brought u a rose today. resize it and make it a lil big. dont change anything now
yes just like the other emoji at the bottom
just big soze no covesion to image

acceptanceCriteria: A single "🌹" text emoji is visible directly above the first romantic line in the Image 1 + timed-lines section.
The 🌹 emoji is larger than the bottom 😍 emoji line via font-size styling only (no image asset).
Only one 🌹 emoji line is rendered (no duplicates).
No other copy, layout ordering, or stage flow changes are introduced beyond replacing the bouquet element with the 🌹 emoji line.

requirements.text: Update the build-time generated-assets verification script (`frontend/scripts/verify-generated-assets.mjs`) so it no longer requires the removed bouquet asset (`rose-bouquet-sketch.dim_1400x900.png`) to be present for a successful build/deploy, while keeping verification for the envelope, Image 1, and Image 2 assets intact.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/scripts/verify-generated-assets.mjs` does not list `rose-bouquet-sketch.dim_1400x900.png` as a required asset.
Build fails if any still-required assets are missing (envelope, dog-holding-rose, lip-biting image), and succeeds without the bouquet asset present.

constraints: Do not modify any user-facing text strings other than adding the single "🌹" emoji line (i.e., do not change the three romantic lines, final note, Image 2 caption, or footer signature text).
Preserve the existing stage flow and one-time timed progression behavior; do not introduce any looping/blinking/restart regressions.
Maintain the global no-placeholder/no-broken-asset behavior (omit failed images without showing broken image icons).
Do not edit any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or any other path listed in `frontend.immutablePaths`.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not add or regenerate any new image assets.
Do not change Image 1 (dog-holding-rose) or Image 2 (lip-biting) assets, filenames, or placement.
Do not change background styling, envelope animation, petals behavior, final note content, or footer styling beyond what is necessary to add the 🌹 emoji line.
